title: Incident Response Threat Report
description: Structured threat analysis report correlating nDPI flow analysis with threat intelligence indicators.

total_flows.description: Total number of network flows parsed from the ndpiReader output

data_sources.description: File paths of all input data sources used in the analysis

threat_intel_matches.description: Each indicator from the threat intel feed that was found in the traffic data. Indicators not observed in any flow must be omitted.

indicator_value.description: The indicator value exactly as it appears in the threat intel feed

threat_name.description: Threat name from the feed entry

matched_flow_ids.description: 1-based flow IDs from ndpiReader output where this indicator was observed

c2_beaconing.description: Command-and-control beaconing activity detected via periodic connection timing analysis.

server_ip.description: Destination IP of the C2 server

mean_interval_sec.description: Mean time in seconds between consecutive beacon connections

hostname.description: TLS SNI / hostname used by the beacon

ja4_fingerprint.description: JA4 TLS client fingerprint of the beacon connections

dns_exfiltration.description: Data exfiltration via DNS subdomain encoding. Encoded subdomain labels must be decoded to reveal the exfiltrated plaintext content.

tunnel_domain.description: Base domain used as the DNS tunnel endpoint (the authoritative domain under which encoded queries are sent)

query_count.description: Total number of tunneling DNS queries observed

flow_id.description: Flow ID of the DNS query

raw_labels.description: The encoded subdomain labels as observed in the DNS query

decoded_text.description: The decoded plaintext content extracted from the encoded labels

credential_exposure.description: Cleartext credential transmissions found in unencrypted protocol flows.

tls_anomalies.description: TLS/certificate anomalies including trust issues, policy violations, and negotiation problems.

anomaly_type.description: Category of the TLS anomaly (e.g. excessive_validity, self_signed, version_downgrade)

details.description: Human-readable explanation of the anomaly with relevant metadata

dga_domains.description: Domains suspected of being algorithmically generated, identified from DNS query analysis.

entropy.description: Shannon entropy of the second-level domain label

attack_timeline.description: Chronologically ordered sequence of significant security events reconstructed from the traffic analysis.

timestamp.description: Unix epoch timestamp of the event
